file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_482.name: file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829
file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_482.description: File a formal dispute for a credit card transaction.

transaction_id.description: The unique identifier for the transaction being disputed

card_action.description: Flag indicating the card's status. Must be one of: 'keep_active' (card remains active, dispute only), 'cancel_and_reissue' (card is being cancelled and replaced). This is for record-keeping only and does NOT order a replacement card.

card_last_4_digits.description: Last 4 digits of the credit card number

full_name.description: Full legal name of the cardholder

user_id.description: The user's unique identifier in the system

contacted_merchant.description: Whether the user attempted to resolve the issue with the merchant first

purchase_date.description: Date when the purchase was made, format MM/DD/YYYY

issue_noticed_date.description: Date when the user noticed the issue, format MM/DD/YYYY

dispute_reason.description: Reason for the dispute. Must be one of: 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge', 'duplicate_charge', 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_received', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging', 'refund_never_processed'

resolution_requested.description: Resolution being requested. Must be one of: 'full_refund', 'partial_refund'

eligible_for_provisional_credit.description: Whether the user is eligible for provisional credit

partial_refund_amount.description: Amount requested for partial refund (required only if resolution_requested is 'partial_refund')

file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_482.success_message: Credit card transaction dispute filed successfully. A case has been opened and will be reviewed within 10 business days.

file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281.name: file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281
file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281.description: File a formal dispute for a debit card transaction under Regulation E. Debit card disputes affect actual bank funds and have different liability rules based on reporting timing.

transaction_id.description: The unique identifier for the transaction being disputed

account_id.description: The checking account ID linked to the debit card

user_id.description: The user's unique identifier in the system

dispute_category.description: Category of the dispute. Must be one of: 'unauthorized_transaction', 'atm_cash_discrepancy', 'atm_deposit_not_credited', 'duplicate_charge', 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_received', 'recurring_charge_after_cancellation', 'card_present_fraud', 'card_not_present_fraud'

transaction_date.description: Date when the transaction occurred, format MM/DD/YYYY

discovery_date.description: Date when the user first noticed the issue, format MM/DD/YYYY

transaction_type.description: Type of transaction. Must be one of: 'pin_purchase', 'signature_purchase', 'online_purchase', 'atm_withdrawal', 'atm_deposit', 'recurring_payment', 'person_to_person'

card_in_possession.description: Whether the customer still has their physical debit card in their possession

pin_compromised.description: Whether the customer's PIN may have been compromised. Must be one of: 'yes_shared', 'yes_observed', 'no', 'unknown'

contacted_merchant.description: Whether the user attempted to resolve the issue with the merchant first

police_report_filed.description: Whether a police report has been filed (recommended for fraud over $500)

written_statement_provided.description: Whether the customer has provided a written statement describing what happened (required for Reg E provisional credit)

provisional_credit_eligible.description: Whether the user is eligible for provisional credit based on Debit Card Provisional Credit Guidelines

customer_max_liability_amount.description: The maximum dollar amount the customer could be liable for based on Regulation E reporting timing rules and the disputed amount. Use -1 for unlimited liability.

card_action.description: Action to take on the card. Must be one of: 'keep_active', 'freeze_pending_investigation', 'close_and_reissue'

file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281.success_message: Debit card transaction dispute filed successfully. A case has been opened and provisional credit determination has been recorded.

set_debit_card_recurring_block_7382.name: set_debit_card_recurring_block_7382
set_debit_card_recurring_block_7382.description: Block or unblock all recurring payments on a debit card. When blocked, all recurring/subscription charges will be declined. One-time purchases are not affected.

card_id.description: The debit card ID to update

block_recurring.description: True to block all recurring payments, False to unblock/allow recurring payments

set_debit_card_recurring_block_7382.success_message: Debit card recurring payment settings updated successfully.

get_debit_dispute_status_7483.name: get_debit_dispute_status_7483
get_debit_dispute_status_7483.description: Retrieve a user's debit card dispute history from the debit_card_disputes table. Returns all debit card disputes filed by the user, including dispute IDs, categories, amounts, statuses, and provisional credit information.

user_id.description: The user's unique identifier in the system

get_debit_dispute_status_7483.success_message: Debit card dispute history retrieved successfully.

order_replacement_credit_card_7291.description: Order a replacement credit card for a customer. The old card will be automatically cancelled when the replacement is ordered.

credit_card_account_id.description: The credit card account ID for the card being replaced

user_id.description: The user's unique identifier in the system

shipping_address.description: Full shipping address where the new card should be sent

reason.description: Reason for replacement. Must be one of: 'fraud_suspected', 'lost', 'stolen', 'damaged', 'expired', 'other'

order_replacement_credit_card_7291.success_message: Replacement credit card order placed successfully. The old card has been cancelled for security.

get_user_dispute_history_7291.name: get_user_dispute_history_7291

get_user_dispute_history_7291.success_message: User transaction dispute history retrieved successfully.

get_closure_reason_history_8293.name: get_closure_reason_history_8293
get_closure_reason_history_8293.description: Retrieve the closure reason history for a specific credit card account.

apply_statement_credit_8472.name: apply_statement_credit_8472
apply_statement_credit_8472.description: Apply a statement credit to a customer's credit card account.

apply_credit_card_account_flag_6147.name: apply_credit_card_account_flag_6147
apply_credit_card_account_flag_6147.description: Apply a flag to a customer's credit card account. Flags can include annual fee waivers, promotional APR rates, rewards bonuses, or other account-level modifiers. Each flag has an effective date and expiration date.

get_credit_limit_increase_history_4829.description: Retrieve the credit limit increase request history for a specific credit card account. Returns all previous CLI requests including dates, amounts, and statuses.

get_payment_history_6183.description: Retrieve payment history for a credit card account.

unfreeze_debit_card_3893.description: Unfreeze a previously frozen debit card.
